panels.description: Minimum across all etcd members. A value of 0 means at least one member has no leader — the cluster may not be quorate.
panels.title: Leader

panels.description: Number of leader changes in the last hour. Frequent elections indicate Raft instability, typically caused by disk or network latency.
panels.title: Leader Changes / 1h

panels.description: Current rate of incoming unary gRPC requests (reads + writes). Informational load context for interpreting the error rate and latency panels.
panels.title: RPC Rate

panels.description: Percentage of unary gRPC requests that failed with a server-side error code. Only infrastructure-failure codes are counted (Unknown, ResourceExhausted, Unavailable, etc.) — application-level codes such as NotFound are excluded.
panels.title: RPC Error %

panels.description: 99th percentile end-to-end latency of unary gRPC requests as seen by the server — the client-visible latency signal for the D in RED. Only populated for the main etcd (requires extensive metrics); empty for events.
panels.title: gRPC p99 Latency

panels.description: Current DB size as a percentage of the configured etcd quota. At 100%, etcd stops accepting writes. Drill down to the DB Size panel for historical context.
panels.title: DB Quota %

panels.description: 99th percentile WAL fsync latency. High values indicate disk I/O saturation and directly cause elevated write latency. Drill down to the Disk Sync Duration panel for historical context.
panels.title: WAL Fsync p99

panels.description: Percentage of the in-use etcd DB currently resident in the page cache via mmap (worst pod). A drop below 100% means the kernel is evicting mapped pages, causing elevated read IOPS. Drill down to the Memory / Page Cache section for details.

targets.expr:
min(
  sum by (pod) (container_memory_mapped_file{container="etcd", pod=~"etcd-(${role:pipe}).*"})
  / sum by (pod) (etcd_mvcc_db_total_size_in_use_in_bytes{container="etcd", pod=~"etcd-(${role:pipe}).*"})
) * 100

panels.title: DB Page Cache %

panels.description: Rate of unary gRPC requests started and failed on the etcd server.
panels.title: RPC Rate

panels.description: Number of currently open bidirectional gRPC streams for Watch and Lease operations.
panels.title: Active Streams

panels.description: Unary gRPC request rate broken down per etcd member. In an HA cluster requests should be roughly balanced; a member consistently handling 2-3x the others indicates a load-distribution problem (e.g. topology-aware routing in kube-apiserver).
panels.title: Request Rate by Member

panels.description: Rate of key-value mutations at the MVCC storage layer. Unlike the gRPC request rate, this counts the actual puts/deletes committed to the DB - a single Kubernetes Txn RPC may contain multiple puts. Drives DB growth, compaction frequency and WAL load.
panels.title: MVCC Operation Rate

panels.description: Number of watch streams currently open on the MVCC store. A continuously growing watcher count is a classic sign of clients (controllers) that open watches without closing them, and increases etcd memory and CPU pressure. Only populated for the main etcd (requires extensive metrics); empty for events.
panels.title: Active Watchers

panels.description: Rate of bytes received by etcd from gRPC clients.
panels.title: Client Traffic In

panels.description: Rate of bytes sent by etcd to gRPC clients.
panels.title: Client Traffic Out

panels.description: Total size of the etcd MVCC database file on disk, including free pages not yet reclaimed by defragmentation.
panels.title: DB Size

panels.description: Percentage of the etcd in-use DB size currently resident in the Linux page cache via mmap. A drop below 100% indicates the kernel is evicting etcd's mapped DB pages, which forces reads back to disk and causes elevated read IOPS.

targets.expr:
100 * (
  sum by (pod) (container_memory_mapped_file{container="etcd", pod=~"etcd-(${role:pipe}).*"})
  /
  sum by (pod) (etcd_mvcc_db_total_size_in_use_in_bytes{container="etcd", pod=~"etcd-(${role:pipe}).*"})
)

panels.title: DB Page Cache Coverage (%)

panels.description: Absolute bytes of etcd's mmap'd file memory resident in the page cache vs. the in-use DB size. When the two lines diverge, pages are being evicted from the cache.
panels.title: DB Page Cache vs DB Size

panels.description: Latency distribution (p50/p90/p99) of unary gRPC requests over time. Use it to correlate latency spikes with disk sync duration, request rate or traffic. The percentile spread shows whether a spike is tail-only (p99 rises, p50 flat) or a distribution-wide shift. Only populated for the main etcd (requires extensive metrics); empty for events.
panels.title: gRPC Request Latency

panels.description: 99th percentile latency of WAL fsync and bbolt backend commit operations. High values indicate I/O saturation and directly contribute to elevated etcd write latency.
panels.title: Disk Sync Duration

panels.description:
One minute rates for all filesystem read operations executed within the container(s).

The data has the following designation scheme: <pod-name> / <container-name>
panels.title: Container Disk Read Throughput (2m rate)

panels.description:
One minute rates for all filesystem write operations executed within the container(s).

The data has the following designation scheme: <pod-name> / <container-name>
panels.title: Container Disk Write Throughput (2m rate)

panels.description: Rate of filesystem read operations inside the etcd container(s) as reported by cAdvisor. A persistent spike here combined with low DB page cache coverage indicates the kernel is evicting mmap'd pages.
panels.title: Container read IOPS

panels.description: Rate of filesystem write operations inside the etcd container(s) as reported by cAdvisor.
panels.title: Container write IOPS

panels.description: Resident set size (RSS) of the etcd process – the physical memory pages currently held in RAM.
panels.title: Memory
